name: erno-modo-marketplace
description: Skills and agents for Claude Code by Hernán De Souza · session memory, knowledge-base lint, topic roadmaps, bionic reading accessibility, team onboarding.

plugins.name: session-recall
plugins.description: Recover compressed context from past Claude Code sessions by topic/keyword. Mines ~/.claude/projects/<encoded>/*.jsonl, ranks by hits + recency, dedupes, drops synthetic turns, and emits a paste-ready context bundle. Includes a companion agent for cross-project synthesis.

plugins.name: session-recap
plugins.description: Weekly cross-source recap for Claude Code users. Crosses GitHub PRs (open + closed) + git log + branches + session transcripts and classifies work as Done · In Progress · Stalled · Local · Abandoned.

plugins.name: topic-roadmap
plugins.description: Inventory cross-source work on a topic — PRs + openspec/SDD changes + docs/RFCs + branches + memories — into a 6-layer lifecycle roadmap (Idea → Discovery → Spec → Implementation → Review → Done) with Mermaid diagram + JSON inventory.

plugins.name: distill-lint
plugins.description: Read-only audit of a Claude Code knowledge base. Detects orphans, stale notes, dead refs, broken cross-references, index-budget violations. Inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki Pattern + Luhmann Zettelkasten. Complements `distill-learnings` (write side).

plugins.name: lectura-bionica
plugins.description: Bionic-reading transformer for Markdown — bold the first half of each word ≥3 letters to create a visual anchor that reduces eye regressions. WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility (SC 1.4.8 + SC 1.4.12) for ADHD/dyslexia readers. Zero deps Python, 24 pytest cases.

plugins.name: modo-team-onboarding
plugins.description: PRIVATE · Generate a MODO-team Claude Code onboarding manual by mining 30d of local sessions plus CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md / MCPs / skills / plugins / agents. Paranoid redact pass (17+ vendor secret patterns, env-style ALL_CAPS lookbehind, allowlist email + UUID + placeholders). Resolves only for users with access to the source repo.
